dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible macro-annuli include a prominent figure-eight shaped structure and several irregular 'O' shaped rings. The outer perimeters of these structures exhibit sharp, high-contrast transitions from the dark primary coat to light interior gradients. The 'O' rings show irregular, jagged edges rather than smooth circular perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high density of small, solid-intensity white punctate spots is visible in the anterior region, particularly around the neck area. These spots lack internal gradients and are distributed in tight, asymmetrical clusters that occur independently of the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A distinct triangular spatial relationship is formed by the centroids of the prominent figure-eight annulus, a large circular annulus located approximately mid-body on the lateral flank, and a smaller, distinct 'O' ring located further towards the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique 'figure-eight' interconnected double-annulus is located on the upper-left visible quadrant of the dorsal surface.
